nota: Bloque 1.1. Tema de decide 30-oct: 'economy'/'quarter' (consumo = motor del PIB Q3). Cifras: BEA Personal Income and Outlays, September 2026: tasa de ahorro 3.8% de la renta disponible, ahorro $911.1B, gasto (PCE) +0.5% ($113.1B), renta personal +0.2% ($54.5B), renta disponible +0.2%. $100 x 3.8% = $3.80 (cálculo propio).

frases.texto: Three dollars and eighty cents. That's what Americans saved from every hundred they took home in September.
The official saving rate: three point eight percent.
So where did the rest go?
Spending jumped zero point five percent in one month.
Income? Up just zero point two.
Spending grew more than twice as fast as paychecks.
Here's the part nobody tells you.
That spending is part of why the economy looks strong right now.
But a strong economy built on a thin cushion is fragile.
So are you saving more than three dollars and eighty cents of every hundred, or less?

estructuras.nombre: contraste (la economía va bien, el colchón no)

frases.texto: Three point eight percent. The economy is booming, but that's all Americans are saving.
In September, that was the share of take-home pay they kept, according to official data.
Spending rose zero point five percent in a month.
On every hundred dollars, that's three dollars and eighty cents saved.
Here's the part nobody tells you.
Growth that runs on spending more than you earn can't run forever.
So is America's economy strong, or just spending its cushion?

ganchos.texto: Americans saved three dollars and eighty cents of every hundred they took home in September.
Three point eight percent. That's how much of their paycheck Americans actually save.
Spending grew more than twice as fast as paychecks in September.

pregunta.nota: Cifra personal ($3.80 de cada $100) + pregunta '¿a dónde fue el resto?' abre el bucle; CTA pide comparar con uno mismo y vuelve a la 1.ª frase.

contraste.nota: 'That gap is the boom' es buen giro, pero el porcentaje abstracto no le habla al espectador y 'booming' exagera.

pregunta+g1.nota: Igual al original sin el 'That's what': pierde el golpe de la cifra sola.

pregunta+g3.nota: Regala el giro del gasto en el segundo 0.
